content: Build a document extraction pipeline that turns uploaded invoices into standardized JSON with vendor, invoice number, due date, total, line items, and source spans.
I normalized this as DocumentArtifact to InvoiceJsonArtifact and found template document_extract_validate_emit.

CandidateBundle: parse DocumentArtifact>ParsedDocument, extract ParsedDocument>RawInvoiceFields, normalize RawInvoiceFields>NormalizedInvoice, validate NormalizedInvoice>ValidatedInvoice, emit ValidatedInvoice>InvoiceJsonArtifact.

I should not write my own PDF parser from scratch or ask a model to validate arbitrary JSON manually. The registry has parse_pdf_text, extract_invoice_fields_bounded, normalize_invoice_fields, and validate_invoice_schema_and_spans.
Compiler rejects generic_json because it lacks the invoice contract and rejects schema_only validation because it lacks source-span validation.
Runtime uses artifact refs for documents, bounded extraction only, schema and span proof requirements, and JSONL ledger redaction.
